equivalence_proof.consequence: argmax_d P(u, v_d | x) = argmax_d P(v_d | x, u)
does_not_extend_to: any tokenizer that is not separately pinned and verified
equivalence_proof.identity: P(u, v_d | x) = P(u | x) * P(v_d | x, u)
equivalence_proof.tie_break_order: ascending mod-10 residue order 0, 1, 2, ..., 9, unchanged from the registered v0.5 order
valid_because: the registered decision statistic is a deterministic argmax over a closed ten-member candidate set
all ten candidates have the same two-token structure
all ten candidates share the identical common prefix token u
the registered digit-order tie break is preserved unchanged
equivalence_proof.why_exact: P(u | x) does not depend on d, so it is a strictly positive common factor of all ten complete-candidate probabilities and cancels from the ranking. This is an exact factor cancellation, not an approximation

first_discriminative_token_rule.common_prefix_is: a teacher-forced candidate prefix. It is not a prompt-rendering change and it is not a generated token
prohibited: pretending the two-token candidate is one token
first_discriminative_token_rule.s2_decision: the deterministic restricted argmax over the ten discriminant logits, mapped back to the complete registered candidate surface
first_discriminative_token_rule.s2_evaluation: one ordinary prefill evaluation on that context, reading the next-token logit vector only at the ten verified discriminant token IDs
first_discriminative_token_rule.s2_scoring_context: the registered prompt token IDs followed by the verified common-prefix token
first_discriminative_token_rule.s2_scoring_context_construction: concatenation of the registered prompt token IDs with the verified common-prefix token ID. The scoring context is never produced by re-encoding a concatenated string, so no additional tokenizer encode is introduced
first_discriminative_token_rule.s3_evaluation: reuse of the exact S2 discriminant-position logit vector on CPU; S3 adds zero model evaluations, model loads, prefills, decodes and generations
first_discriminative_token_rule.tie_break_order: ascending mod-10 residue order 0, 1, 2, ..., 9, unchanged from draft-v0.5

separators.r_instr_separator_equals_r_base: R-instr holds the separator byte-identical to R-base because R-instr varies the instruction sentence only
separators.semantics: K6-SEP varies the separator between a DISPLAYED OPTION LABEL and its DISPLAYED OPTION CONTENT. A profile that renders neither has no referent for the factor.

supersedes.why: draft-v0.5 remains the record of what was registered when P0-T ran. It is never edited, and the P0-T observations are never restated against a surface that did not exist when they were made

token_accounting.s3_note: S3 reuses the S2 discriminant-position logit vector on CPU, so it processes no token and performs no sequence-level evaluation. Its scoring-context token count records the S2 context it rescores, which is why the two profiles report the same context length
